hero.title:

with certified tech freelancers from LATAM.
hero.subtitle: Work on demand with validated IT talent paying locally for the time worked in a legal, transparent way, all in one place.

servicios.title: Our Services
servicios.subtitle: We offer comprehensive solutions for your company. We take care of managing top-level talent in Latin America, simplifying processes and guaranteeing successful results.
servicios.freelancingDesc: Ready manages everything: Search, selection, hiring and payment of the freelancer, while you only sign with us and receive local invoicing.
servicios.payrollDesc: We manage payments to your talent throughout Latin America, guaranteeing security, punctuality and flexibility in USD or local currency, without complications.
servicios.headhuntingDesc: We find the ideal professional for your team and you take care of hiring them directly. We only charge per successful hire.

proceso.title: Our Process
proceso.readyDesc: Define the profile, seniority and work modality you need, whether Full time or Part Time.
proceso.setDesc: We present you with available certified freelancers that best match your needs.
proceso.goDesc: Interview and start working with freelancers while Ready takes care of all the administrative process.

selloReady.title: Ready Seal
selloReady.calidadDesc: We interview and filter with rigorous technical tests the best tech talent in Latin America.
selloReady.garantiaDesc: We protect and constantly monitor the performance of Ready freelancers.
selloReady.flexibilidadDesc: Work for as long as you need, with the best digital professionals from Latam without having to hire them.
selloReady.pagoLocalDesc: We invoice in your country of origin and pay the freelancer anywhere in the world.
selloReady.description: Every Ready freelancer goes through a rigorous technical validation process, ensuring quality, transparency and results from day one.
selloReady.tagline: The most validated tech talent in Latin America

testimonios.title: Client Testimonials
testimonios.t1Quote: With Ready we have had an excellent experience. They take care of everything: contracts, NDAs, billing and payments, accompanying us at every stage. Thanks to them we work with the highest quality professionals in Latin America. 100% recommended.
testimonios.t2Quote: Ready is the best. It helps us a lot to build teams of highly trained IT freelancers, very quickly and for flexible periods. I recommend them every chance I get because they really solve everything!.
testimonios.t3Quote: With Ready we solved a big problem: complying with our legal and vendor policies without complications. We pay directly to Ready and they manage the entire process with the freelancers.

plataforma.title: Manage your freelancers with Ready
plataforma.subtitle: Discover the key elements that make Ready the best option to connect with top-level talent and manage your projects efficiently.
plataforma.pagosDesc: Pay your talent from anywhere in Latin America in USD or the local currency of your choice.
plataforma.seguimientoDesc: Effectively track the progress and hours worked by your team.
plataforma.complianceDesc: Comply with local hiring laws, always protected through our service contracts for talent throughout Latin America.
plataforma.presupuestoDesc: Maintain control of spending by the hour, day or week, as your projects progress.

network.title: The Largest certified IT freelancer
